reviewer: Codex merchant owner, actual images inspected

views.name: hull_rig
findings: The three-mast barque rig shows separate square canvas, stays and ratlines; the after fore-and-aft canvas and spars remain readable against the grey background.
The ochre planked hull, individual gun stations, framed stern lights and external rudder remain visible under the full rig; the open waist remains readable below the rig.
views.scope: Whole actual GLB with all visible hull, rig and sails.

views.name: deck_closeup
findings: The coamed hatch exposes a complete timber stair with separate treads and side rails, with actual planked space and cargo visible below.
Fine lengthwise grain and staggered plank seams are visible across the deck; the capstan has a separate octagonal head, whelps, messenger turns and removable bars beside the textured gun carriage.
views.scope: Actual deck and fitting close-up at a fixed 4.5 metre physical field; rig hidden for visibility.

views.name: hold_interior
findings: Curved hull frames, horizontal inner strakes, overhead beams and hanging knees are clearly visible, with lengthwise timber grain on the frames and large mast.
The planked sole leaves clear passage alongside the mast and its wooden partner; a strapped crate with a ring-handled lantern and farther casks give the intact hold a readable cargo scale.
The intact hold shows substantially more explicit framing and deck support than the matched Brig reference view; auxiliary review lighting makes the nearest wood surfaces visible.
views.scope: Camera inside the actual enclosed GLB room; auxiliary camera fill reveals timber and furniture.

views.name: hold_cutaway
findings: The labelled cutaway exposes the long planked hold sole, curved frame sequence and several complete timber access flights, making the connected working floor readable.

Casks and locker/lantern fittings stand beside the floor routes; original upper guns and rig fittings remain visible while their enclosing deck/hull surfaces are temporarily hidden for this structural view.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.

views.name: cabin_interior
findings: The intact cabin shows vertical grain in the bulkhead and aftermast, visible overhead deck beams, and a planked sole with clear floor on both sides of the mast partner.
A chart table, bench and ring-handled lantern are visible to port, with mattress/pillow and a strapped chest to starboard; the real doorway is partly occluded by the preserved central mast.

At the matched 20 mm lens and 1.23 m eye height, grain, bench joinery and extra fittings read clearly against the original Brig cabin reference; the separate cutaway supplements the cropped berth and doorway view.
views.scope: Camera inside the actual enclosed GLB room; auxiliary camera fill reveals timber and furniture.

views.name: cabin_cutaway
findings: The labelled cutaway reveals the berth frame, mattress and pillow, a strapped planked chest, chart table, and the close-stool with a genuinely open seat and raised lid.
Curved stern framing and the small glazed transom lights remain inspectable; the retained upper-deck guns and rig fittings appear above the exposed cabin layer.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.
